idea-plugin.name: spek - OpenSpec Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
spek is an OpenSpec content viewer that lets you browse specs, changes, and task progress directly within your IDE.

Features:

  • Specs Browser — Browse spec documents with BDD syntax highlighting (WHEN/GIVEN, THEN, AND, MUST/SHALL)
  • Changes Browser — View changes with a tab per artifact the change contains (custom OpenSpec schemas supported), with the change's schema shown as a badge; rows surface creation/archive dates and lifecycle duration
  • Timeline — Horizontal Gantt-style chart of every change's lifecycle, with optional spec-topic grouping and an auto-scaling time axis
  • Task Progress — Track task completion with section-grouped progress bars
  • Graph View — Interactive force-directed graph showing spec-change relationships
  • Full-text Search — Search across all specs and changes
  • Spec Diff — Compare current spec content against historical change versions
  • Live Reload — Automatically refreshes when openspec files change on disk
  • Collapsible Tree Navigator — A Specs / Changes tree sits above the viewer. Hide it from the tool window title bar or the gear menu to give the viewer the whole tool window; the choice and the split ratio are remembered per project
  • Dark / Light Theme — Syncs with your IDE theme

Supported IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, PhpStorm, GoLand, RubyMine, CLion, Rider, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs (2023.3+)

Getting Started: Open a project that contains an openspec/ directory. The spek tool window will appear in the right sidebar.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.20.0

Highlight: mermaid diagrams are drawn. A design document usually explains a project's shape with a picture, and Mermaid is how that picture is written in Markdown. spek showed a mermaid code block as highlighted source, so the one part of a design meant to be looked at was the one shown as text. Thanks to @gokul-kulkarni (Gokul Kulkarni) (#55)

  • A mermaid code block is drawn as a diagram in every Markdown artifact — proposal, design, tasks, and main and delta specs
  • A .mmd / .mermaid file at a change's root is an artifact: its own tab, counted in the change-list badge, reachable by search, and refreshed live on edit
  • A diagram can be zoomed and panned, and can show its source
  • A diagram that fails to parse shows the error and its source; the rest of the document renders as before
  • Diagram colours come from spek's theme, follow the light / dark switch and meet the same contrast rules as the rest of the app. Each slice of a pie chart gets its own colour
  • The drawing code loads only when a page holds a diagram; a repository with none never loads it
  • The graph no longer draws labels on top of other nodes (#66). The layout left room for each node but not for the label under it, so labels landed on neighbouring nodes and on each other — on one 25-node graph, 20 labels sat on a node. The layout now makes room for every label, fills a wide window instead of forming a disc, and comes out the same on every load. Thanks to @sammcj (Sam McLeod)
  • Pages declare English as their language (#63). They declared Traditional Chinese, so Firefox offered to translate every page, and the browser picked Chinese fallback fonts, which made the text jump further when the UI font arrived. Thanks to @sammcj (Sam McLeod)
